### Patch Changes

- 7e55599: feat(gateway): support Live models over WebSocket

  - `gateway.experimental_realtime()` returns a continuous Live model for `openai/gpt-live-1` and `openai/gpt-live-1.1`. It connects to the Gateway Live route and speaks the normalized Live protocol (`session-start`, PCM16 audio, `context-append`, `session-close` with final usage). Pass `{ api: 'live' }` for other Live model IDs or `{ api: 'realtime' }` to force the realtime route. Before, these model IDs opened the realtime route, which rejected them with `invalid_model`.
  - `gateway.experimental_realtime.getToken()` mints Live-bound client secrets for Live models.
  - `experimental_useRealtime` and the realtime session can connect a continuous model straight to the provider with a short-lived token (`api.token`) when the model explicitly declares the `client-secret-websocket` connection. Before, continuous WebSocket sessions required an application relay.

- Updated dependencies [7e55599]
- Updated dependencies [beccad3]
  - @ai-sdk/gateway@4.0.152

releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Action required**
>
> - If you use `requireMcpAuth` without an `issuer` option and verify tokens against keys fetched from a URL (`jwksUrl` or the JWT plugin's `jwks.remoteUrl`), make sure tokens carry the discovery issuer, or pass `issuer` explicitly. ([#12714](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12714))
> - If you verify OAuth provider tokens outside Better Auth against a pinned `jwt.issuer` or base URL, switch to the discovery `issuer`, and accept both values until JWT access tokens issued before the upgrade expire. ([#12714](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12714))
> - If you throw from `customTokenResponseFields` or an `extensions[].claims.idToken` contributor to refuse tokens, move that check to `beforeTokenIssuance`. ([#12663](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12663))
> - If you use CIBA, run `npx auth@latest migrate`, or `npx auth@latest generate` and apply the schema with your ORM, before you upgrade to add the new `approvedViaConsent` column on the `cibaRequest` model. ([#12801](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12801))
> - If you have OAuth resources with an empty stored `allowedScopes` that relied on denying every scope, set `disabled: true` on each (or give it real scopes) before the first 1.8 process starts, and remove any config `allowedScopes: []`, which now fails at startup. ([#12743](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12743))
> - If you use CIBA with `approvalPage`, record each decision with `auth.api.completeCibaRequest`, and if your code extends `CibaOptions` with `interface`, use an intersection type instead. If your `sendNotification` uses `url` as a string, check it for `undefined`. ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
> - If you use CIBA, run `npx auth@latest migrate` with the built-in Kysely adapter, or run `npx auth@latest generate` and apply the schema with your ORM, to add the `actor` column to `cibaRequest` before you upgrade. ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
> - feat(ciba)!: require client authentication; 401 for invalid_client ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
>
>   CIBA deployments can now read a pending request on their own approval page with the new server-only `auth.api.getCibaRequest({ body: { requestId, userId } })`. It returns what to show the user (client, scopes, resources, binding message, ACR values, authorization details, actor, and expiry), or `null` when `completeCibaRequest` would refuse the request as unknown, such as a decided or expired request or one for another user, and when the client no longer exists. `sendNotification` now also receives the requested `resources`.
> - If your client handles `/oauth2/bc-authorize` errors, expect status 401 with `invalid_client` instead of 400, including when the request has no `client_id`. ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
> - If you set `allowPublicClients`, remove it and register those clients with a secret or with `private_key_jwt`. ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
> - If you use the OAuth provider, run `npx auth@latest migrate`, or generate and apply the schema, to add the `accessTokenFormat` column to `oauthResource` before deploying, or every request will fail the schema check. ([#12656](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12656))
> - If a relying party sits on an internal network and its public-looking name resolves to a private address, list its exact origin in `trustedOrigins` to keep delivering logout tokens to it. ([#12697](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12697))
> - If you use CIBA ping mode with a client whose notification endpoint resolves to a private or internal address, list that endpoint's origin in `trustedOrigins` at initialization to keep receiving pings. ([#12690](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12690))
> - If you use a custom `jwt.sign` in the JWT plugin, make it apply its `header` argument, which carries `typ: at+jwt`, or the provider will reject its access tokens. ([#12667](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12667))
> - If a client reads `name` or `picture` from UserInfo and expects an empty string, handle the missing key, or return the claim from `customUserInfoClaims`. ([#12803](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12803))
> - feat(mcp)!: pass requireMcpAuth handlers the sub the token carries ([#12672](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12672))
>
>   `requireMcpAuth` passes the handler the `sub` the access token carries, as in 1.7, instead of the internal user ID that 1.8.0-beta.10 passed. For a client with `subject_type: "pairwise"`, an opaque token's `sub` is now its pairwise subject, as at `/oauth2/introspect`, and a JWT's `sub` is the pairwise subject when the provider sets `accessTokenSubject: "pairwise"`. Other tokens keep the user ID.
>
>   **Breaking for 1.8.0-beta.10 users:** beta.10 passed the user ID even for pairwise tokens. An MCP handler that looks users up by `sub` for pairwise clients must now map the pairwise subject itself, or keep those clients on `subject_type: "public"`.
> - If your clients rotate `private_key_jwt` keys, keep the `jwks_uri` reachable, publish the new key and wait 5 minutes before signing with it. ([#12700](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12700))
> - If you want a user's OAuth tokens to stay valid across a password reset, set `revokeGrantsOnPasswordReset: false`. ([#12738](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12738))
> - If you rely on `getOAuthConsent` or `getOAuthConsents` returning only the last approval, or on the consent page appearing again for previously approved access, update that code; consents now accumulate everything the user approved and did not take back. ([#12798](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12798))

## `better-auth`

### Features

- Added `tokenEndpoint`, `userInfoEndpoint`, and `jwksEndpoint` overrides to social providers so you can point them at a local OAuth emulator or sandbox ([#12746](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12746))
- Added `prepareDeviceCodeRedemption` so custom device code issuers can run a final check before the code is spent ([#12663](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12663))
- Added an `onPasswordReset` plugin hook that runs after a password reset, including for users with no live session ([#12738](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12738))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/de4a6a1bb9352f1a8cd4160f7c79cb578ff49f4a/packages/better-auth/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/oauth-provider`

### ❗ Breaking Changes

- Changed the OAuth consent page to add each approval to the user's stored consent instead of replacing it ([#12798](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12798))
- Changed the OAuth provider to refetch a client's `jwks_uri` for an unknown key at most once every 60 seconds ([#12700](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12700))
- Changed UserInfo to omit the `name` and `picture` claims when the user's name or image is an empty string ([#12803](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12803))
- Changed the OAuth provider to accept JWT access tokens only when their header has `typ: at+jwt` ([#12667](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12667))
- Fixed back-channel logout to skip delivery to a `backchannel_logout_uri` whose host resolves to a non-public address ([#12697](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12697))
- Changed OAuth resource `allowedScopes` to a single storable contract, where an empty stored list now allows every requested scope instead of denying all ([#12743](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12743))
- Fixed OAuth provider tokens to carry the same `iss` as the discovery `issuer`, so clients and the end-session endpoint accept them ([#12714](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12714))

### Features

- Added `serverContext` to `provider.issueAuthorizationCode()` so plugin endpoints can store values with a code and read them back when it is redeemed ([#12676](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12676))
- Added a `beforeTokenIssuance` option that lets you refuse token issuance for any grant before any token is stored ([#12663](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12663))
- Changed `customTokenResponseFields` and `extensions[].claims.idToken` contributors to run after the DPoP check and `beforeTokenIssuance` ([#12663](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12663))
- Added a `beforeAuthorization` option to run a policy on each authorization request, such as requiring a new sign-in or refusing the request ([#12657](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12657))
- Added an `amr` option to `provider.issueAuthorizationCode()` so plugin endpoints can report the authentication methods they verified ([#12654](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12654))
- Added `provider.validateAuthorizationRequest()` so plugin endpoints can reject an invalid OAuth authorization request before the user signs in ([#12654](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12654))
- Added support for a function-valued `accessTokenExpiresIn` to set access token lifetime per user grant, capped by the new `accessTokenMaxExpiresIn` ([#12740](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12740))
- Added an `idToken: false` option to `issueTokens` so extension grants can skip the ID token while keeping the `openid` scope ([#12665](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12665))
- Added `tokenResponseFields` so OAuth provider extensions can add their own fields to the token response ([#12664](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12664))
- Added `grantId` to claim callbacks and `customTokenResponseFields` so apps can tell separate authorizations apart across refreshes ([#12662](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12662))
- Changed refresh token replay to revoke only the affected grant instead of every refresh token the client holds for the user ([#12754](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12754))
- Added an `onTokenRevoked` option that reports revoked grants and access tokens so you can notify resource servers or keep an audit log ([#12678](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12678))
- Improved `provider.issueAuthorizationCode()` to reuse same-request `authenticateClient()` and `verifyDpopProof()` results instead of rejecting them as replayed ([#12759](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12759))
- Added revocation of a user's OAuth access and refresh tokens, including `offline_access` grants, on password reset when `emailAndPassword.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset` is enabled ([#12738](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12738))
- Added a per-resource `accessTokenFormat: "opaque"` option so protected resources can receive opaque access tokens instead of JWTs ([#12656](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12656))
- Changed OAuth authorization requests without `scope` to use the intersection of the client's registered scopes and `clientRegistrationDefaultScopes` ([#12742](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12742))

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed revoked sessions being able to approve or deny interaction requests, such as CIBA requests or OAuth device codes, while `session.cookieCache` still served them ([#12690](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12690))
- Fixed device codes to be rejected with `invalid_grant` when the user's stored consent was deleted or narrowed after approval ([#12790](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12790))
- Fixed authorization codes to be rejected with `invalid_grant` when the user's stored consent was deleted or narrowed after the code was issued ([#12737](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12737))
- Fixed the OAuth provider token endpoint to exchange authorization codes that carry no scopes instead of rejecting them with `invalid_scope` ([#12741](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12741))
- Fixed concurrent matching refresh requests to get the same rotated response instead of `invalid_grant` when `refreshTokenReuseInterval` is set ([#12739](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12739))
- Fixed deleting an OAuth consent to also revoke the access and refresh tokens issued under it ([#12736](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12736))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/de4a6a1bb9352f1a8cd4160f7c79cb578ff49f4a/packages/oauth-provider/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/ciba`

### ❗ Breaking Changes

- Added a CIBA `approvalPage` option so requests are approved only on your own page or app, and `/oauth2/authorize` no longer approves them ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
- Added CIBA delegated access tokens that name the user as `sub` and an actor as the `act` claim, using the new `resolveActor` option ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
- feat(ciba)!: require client authentication; 401 for invalid_client ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
- Changed CIBA `/oauth2/bc-authorize` to answer `invalid_client` with status 401 and a `WWW-Authenticate` challenge instead of 400 ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))
- Removed the CIBA `allowPublicClients` option, so clients using `token_endpoint_auth_method: "none"` are now always rejected with `invalid_client` ([#12712](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12712))

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed CIBA requests approved from a link so they can no longer be redeemed after the user deletes or narrows the stored consent ([#12801](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12801))
- Fixed CIBA ping mode to re-check the notification endpoint's host and skip the ping when it resolves to a non-public address ([#12690](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12690))
- Fixed CIBA ping notifications so providers running on Cloudflare Workers can deliver them to clients ([#12690](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12690))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/de4a6a1bb9352f1a8cd4160f7c79cb578ff49f4a/packages/ciba/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/mcp`

### ❗ Breaking Changes

- feat(mcp)!: pass requireMcpAuth handlers the sub the token carries ([#12672](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12672))
- Changed `requireMcpAuth` to expect the OAuth provider's discovery issuer by default, which follows a custom `jwt.issuer` ([#12714](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12714))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/de4a6a1bb9352f1a8cd4160f7c79cb578ff49f4a/packages/mcp/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/cimd`

### Features

- Added `createCimdMetadataResolver` so runtimes that build the auth instance per request can share one CIMD metadata cache, fetch limits, and in-flight fetches ([#12745](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12745))

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed CIMD so a flood of refused `client_id` URLs no longer exhausts the metadata fetch budget and makes allowed clients fail with `temporarily_unavailable` ([#12744](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12744))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/de4a6a1bb9352f1a8cd4160f7c79cb578ff49f4a/packages/cimd/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/core`

### Features

- Added `tokenEndpoint`, `userInfoEndpoint`, and `jwksEndpoint` overrides to social providers so you can point them at a local OAuth emulator or sandbox ([#12746](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12746))
- Added an `onPasswordReset` plugin hook that runs after a password reset, including for users with no live session ([#12738](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12738))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/de4a6a1bb9352f1a8cd4160f7c79cb578ff49f4a/packages/core/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: ai@7.0.178
releases.body:
### Patch Changes

- 0b8cbfa: `generateText` and `streamText` passed the messages array that `prepareStep` returned to tools and tool approval functions as it was. When `prepareStep` returned the same array for several steps or calls, tool approval functions could not tell the tool calls of one model response from the tool calls of another. The messages array of every step is now created for that step, so the messages that `prepareStep` returns are copied.
- 6815153: fix(ai): forward the `preliminary` flag on provider-executed tool results in `streamText`, so preliminary results (e.g. OpenAI image generation previews) are no longer recorded as final tool results in step content and response messages
- 15bfd6b: add telemetry, runtime context and lifecycle callbacks to `experimental_extract`
- 15bfd6b: redact file urls from download errors sent to telemetry
- 2613bb4: fix(ai): build the `ai`, `ai/internal`, and `ai/test` entrypoints together so their types stay compatible with each other
- 63593a7: With `experimental_toolApprovalSecret` configured, `generateText` and `streamText` signed the approval request of a tool call that the tool approval policy had denied automatically. A client that controls the message history could send that request back with an approved response and have the denied tool call executed. Approval requests of automatically denied tool calls are no longer signed, so such a response is rejected with `AI_InvalidToolApprovalSignatureError`.

  Signatures that earlier versions issued for automatic denials stay valid. To invalidate them, rotate the secret passed to `experimental_toolApprovalSecret`. Approval requests that are still waiting for a user decision then have to be requested again.

- Updated dependencies [1d2c2ff]
- Updated dependencies [a51981c]
- Updated dependencies [875de7b]
  - @ai-sdk/provider-utils@5.0.83
  - @ai-sdk/gateway@4.0.151

releases.name: v1.7.27
releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Action required**
>
> - If you have no key for `jwks.keyPairConfig.alg` and your newest key uses another `jwks.keyPairConfigs` algorithm, your ID tokens, `/token` JWTs, and cookie-cache JWTs change `alg` and `kid` on the next unpinned signature, so update verifiers that hard-code the old algorithm or never refetch the JWKS for an unknown `kid`. ([#12655](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12655))
> - If you want to keep rejecting a `client_uri` on a different origin than the `client_id`, add `"client_uri"` to `originBoundFields`, which now defaults to `["post_logout_redirect_uris"]`. ([#12822](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12822))

## `better-auth`

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed the phone number plugin returning a 500 instead of a 400 from `/update-user` when the request has no body ([#12810](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12810))
- Fixed the username plugin returning a 500 on `/sign-up/email` and `/update-user` when the request has no body; it now returns the same 400 as without the plugin ([#12810](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12810))
- Fixed `/sign-in/anonymous` to validate the request origin, returning a 403 for browser requests from origins outside `trustedOrigins` ([#12809](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12809))
- Fixed unpinned tokens such as ID tokens and session JWTs to prefer a key for the primary `jwks.keyPairConfig.alg` algorithm ([#12655](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12655))
- Fixed `getTestInstance` from `better-auth/test` to run every instance cleanup even when one fails, so databases and connections are not left open ([#12553](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12553))
- Fixed `POST` requests without a body, such as `/sign-out` or `/revoke-sessions`, failing with a 415 on Deno, Next.js, Nuxt and other servers that pass an empty body stream ([#12805](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12805))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/a8fd94a268ad0c78e93cdef341bde463969f8a9a/packages/better-auth/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/oauth-provider`

### Features

- Added the `isCrossOriginJwksUriAllowed` option to `cimd()` so you can accept Client ID Metadata Document clients whose `jwks_uri` is on a different origin than their `client_id` ([#12823](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12823))
- Fixed administrator updates to discovered clients that publish keys at a `jwks_uri`, such as setting `client_credentials_scopes` through `adminUpdateOAuthClient` ([#12823](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12823))
- Added the `jwksStaleIfError` option to keep verifying client assertions with cached `jwks_uri` keys while refetching fails transiently ([#12824](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12824))
- Added the `requireOpenId` option to `oauthProvider` to reject `/oauth2/authorize` requests that lack the `openid` scope with `invalid_scope` ([#12729](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12729))
- Added the `resourceSeedScope` option to `oauthProvider` so apps that build Better Auth on every request can stop re-reading `oauthResource` each time ([#12733](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12733))
- Added `advertisedMetadata.token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported` so providers can advertise accepted token endpoint client authentication methods, including public clients ([#12732](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12732))

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed Client ID Metadata Document and `jwks_uri` responses refused before their body is read, such as error statuses or non-JSON content types, holding connections open ([#12819](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12819))
- Fixed the signed OAuth query failing with `invalid_signature` when a proxy, router, or login page URL-decodes it once ([#12728](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12728))
- Fixed the end-session endpoint to accept issued ID token hints when the issuer ends with a trailing slash ([#12713](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12713))
- Fixed signing keys and post-logout redirect URIs removed from a client's metadata document continuing to work after a refresh ([#12821](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12821))
- Fixed concurrent first requests from the same Client ID Metadata Document client failing with a server error when the database wraps the unique-constraint error ([#12820](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12820))
- Fixed refresh tokens without `offline_access` to stop working once their session expires or is deleted ([#12812](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12812))
- Fixed a client losing its `offline_access` grants on other devices after using a session-bound refresh token following sign-out ([#12812](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12812))
- Fixed `oauthProviderClient` to send form-encoded bodies as form fields and leave non-object JSON bodies such as arrays unchanged ([#12726](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12726))
- Fixed `oauthProviderClient` to stop rewriting request bodies on pages whose query string is not a signed OAuth query ([#12726](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12726))
- Fixed back-channel logout, `jwks_uri` client authentication, and Client ID Metadata Document fetches failing on Cloudflare Workers ([#12817](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12817))
- Fixed OIDC SSO sign-in with `signIn.sso` to resume the OAuth authorization instead of leaving the user on the sign-in `callbackURL` ([#12727](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12727))
- Fixed `private_key_jwt` clients losing their cached `jwks_uri` key set while still authenticating when more than 500 key sets are cached ([#12721](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12721))
- Improved `private_key_jwt` authentication so concurrent assertions for the same `jwks_uri` share a single fetch of the client's key set ([#12721](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12721))
- Fixed `/oauth2/introspect` to return the client ID as `sub` for JWT `client_credentials` tokens issued to pairwise clients ([#12671](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12671))

## `@better-auth/cimd`

## :sparkles: Highlights

### :star2: Toggle and ToggleGroup components

New [`Toggle`](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/toggle) and [`ToggleGroup`](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/toggle-group) components let you build buttons that can be pressed on or off, alone or as a group where `type="multiple"` allows several at once:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const bold = ref(false)
const align = ref('left')
</script>

<template>
  <UToggle v-model="bold" icon="i-lucide-bold" aria-label="Bold" />

  <UToggleGroup
    v-model="align"
    :items="[
      { value: 'left', icon: 'i-lucide-align-left', 'aria-label': 'Left' },
      { value: 'center', icon: 'i-lucide-align-center', 'aria-label': 'Center' },
      { value: 'right', icon: 'i-lucide-align-right', 'aria-label': 'Right' }
    ]"
  />
</template>
```

> [!TIP]
> They take the `Button` props, plus `active-color` and `active-variant` for the pressed state.

### :paperclip: Files in ChatPrompt

The [`ChatPrompt`](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/chat-prompt#files) component now accepts files with `v-model:files`, pasted or dropped on the prompt and listed with the new [`ChatAttachment`](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/chat-attachment) component:

```vue
<template>
  <UChatPrompt v-model="input" v-model:files="files" @submit="onSubmit">
    <UChatPromptSubmit :status="status" />
  </UChatPrompt>
</template>
```

> [!TIP]
> Use `toFileUIParts` from `@nuxt/ui/utils/ai` to send them with the AI SDK, and `v-model:queue` to [queue the messages](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/components/chat-prompt#queue) sent while a response is streaming.

### :bell: Promise toasts

A new [`promise`](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/composables/use-toast#promise) method on `useToast` shows a loading toast and updates it when the promise settles:

```ts
const toast = useToast()

await toast.promise($fetch('/api/save', { method: 'POST' }), {
  loading: 'Saving...',
  success: { title: 'Saved', color: 'success' },
  error: (error: any) => ({ title: error.message, color: 'error' })
})
```

### :art: ESLint config

Nuxt UI now ships an [ESLint config](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/getting-started/integrations/eslint/nuxt) that checks your Tailwind CSS classes against your theme, like `text-gray-500` where a semantic token such as `text-muted` exists:

```ts [nuxt.config.ts]
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  modules: ['@nuxt/eslint', '@nuxt/ui'],
  css: ['~/assets/css/main.css'],
  ui: {
    eslint: true
  }
})
```

> [!NOTE]
> It needs `eslint-plugin-better-tailwindcss` installed. Check the [Vue guide](https://ui.nuxt.com/docs/getting-started/integrations/eslint/vue) to use it without Nuxt.

## :lock: Security

Completes the fix for [GHSA-x9jw-j844-v24h](https://github.com/nuxt/ui/security/advisories/GHSA-x9jw-j844-v24h). In `4.12.1`, an `as` string carrying attributes (for example `as="img src=x onerror=…"`) was written into the opening tag during SSR, so apps rendering untrusted markdown were still open to stored XSS, even with the latest `comark` or `@nuxtjs/mdc`. An `as` that isn't a plain tag name now falls back to the default element, and element-like `template` objects are rejected too. Update from `4.12.1` if you render markdown that users or an LLM can write.

releases.name: v4.12.1
releases.body:
## :lock: Security

This release fixes [GHSA-x9jw-j844-v24h](https://github.com/nuxt/ui/security/advisories/GHSA-x9jw-j844-v24h), a critical issue where untrusted markdown rendered through Nuxt UI components could run code on the server.

You're affected if your app **server renders markdown that users or an LLM can write** (chat messages, comments, CMS previews) with `comark`, `@nuxtjs/mdc` or `@nuxt/content`. Sites that only render their own markdown files aren't. Update to `4.12.1` even if you already updated `comark` or `@nuxtjs/mdc`, they don't cover every case on their own.

Components no longer render an `as` value or an icon that is a plain object with a `template` string or a forged VNode, and an `as` like `script` or `iframe` falls back to the default element. Passing a `{ template }` component as `as` or as an icon, which only worked with the runtime compiler, now renders the default element instead.

## :bug: Bug Fixes

* **components:** ignore components compiled from a template string ([7e07a52](https://github.com/nuxt/ui/commit/7e07a529fe0d7e176ae0deab07835dd66afd39ab))

releases.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Action required**
>
> - If you use a read replica for your verification store, make sure it reads its own writes, because every setup now writes a verification row per revoked grant and a lagging replica can let in-flight requests keep their tokens. ([#12581](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12581))
> - If you want `requireMcpAuth` to keep verifying JWT signatures alone instead of checking the provider's records, set `jwksUrl`. ([#12597](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12597))
> - If you have a grant extension that passes `act` to `issueTokens`, set `sub_profile: "service"` on client actors, or pairwise clients will see those client IDs as pairwise values. ([#12584](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12584))
> - If you have a `may_act` that names a service by `sub`, add `sub_profile: "service"` so it keeps its client ID. ([#12584](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12584))
> - If you return `undefined` from `customAccessTokenClaims` or other claim sources to remove a claim set elsewhere, return a value such as `null` instead, because the lower-priority value now stays. ([#12575](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12575))
> - If you have a custom `clientAuthentication` strategy that compares `aud` with `expectedAudience`, move it to `acceptedAudiences` and pass that to `consumeClientAssertion`. ([#12599](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12599))
> - If you have clients that sign client assertions for an endpoint URL, update them to use the issuer as `aud`, or set `assertionAudience: "issuer-or-endpoint"` temporarily to keep accepting them. ([#12599](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12599))
> - If your authorization server accepts only its token endpoint URL as the assertion audience, set `audience: "token_endpoint"`. ([#12599](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12599))
> - If you sign in to a Better Auth 1.8 authorization server with `private_key_jwt`, set `oidcConfig.clientAssertionAudience: "issuer"`. ([#12599](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12599))
> - If you send UserInfo requests with an `Authorization` header that has no `Bearer` or `DPoP` scheme, send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. If you handle the old `400 invalid_scope` response, handle `403 insufficient_scope` instead. ([#12605](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12605))
> - If your provider publishes discovery at a non-well-known path or under another name for the same issuer, set `issuer` to the issuer identifier the provider documents. If its discovery document has no `issuer`, configure `authorizationUrl`, `tokenUrl`, and `userInfoUrl` instead of `discoveryUrl`. ([#12585](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12585))
> - If you set `ba_sub` in `customAccessTokenClaims`, an extension, or a resource's `customClaims`, rename your claim. ([#12577](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12577))
> - If you call `requireActiveAccessToken` and then `enforceDpopBinding` on an endpoint, replace both calls with `provider.verifyResourceRequest()`, which checks the DPoP proof. ([#12606](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12606))
> - If you pass `authorization_details_types_supported` to `getProtectedResourceMetadata`, wrap the value in an array. ([#12513](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12513))
> - If you match `body.error === "invalid_token"` to catch a missing or unsupported `Authorization` scheme, check for a 401 without `body.error` instead. ([#12512](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12512))
> - If you have exhaustive checks over `DpopBindingErrorCode` or `DpopProofErrorCode`, add a case for `use_dpop_nonce` so the code typechecks. ([#12511](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12511))
> - If you use CIBA, run `npx auth@latest migrate`, or `npx auth@latest generate` and apply the schema with your ORM, before you upgrade to add the `acrValues` and `authorizationDetails` columns to the `cibaRequest` model. ([#12509](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12509))
> - If you use the OAuth provider, add the `requirePushedAuthorizationRequests` column to the `oauthClient` table before deploying, even with PAR disabled, because requests fail until it exists: run `npx auth@latest migrate` with the built-in Kysely adapter, or `npx auth@latest generate` and apply the schema with your ORM. ([#12518](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12518))
> - If you use the OAuth provider, run `npx auth@latest migrate` before upgrading, or run `npx auth@latest generate` and apply the schema with your ORM's migration tool, to add the `accessTokenClaims` column to `oauthAccessToken`. ([#12508](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12508))
> - If you use `oauthProvider()`, before deploying run `npx auth@latest migrate` with the built-in Kysely adapter, or run `npx auth@latest generate` and apply the schema with your ORM, to add the `grantId` columns to `oauthRefreshToken` and `oauthAccessToken`. ([#12520](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12520))
> - If you have a custom `OAuthProviderApi` implementation, add the `challengeDpopNonce()` method. ([#12522](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12522))

## `better-auth`

### ❗ Breaking Changes

- Changed `createPrivateKeyJwtClientAssertionGetter` to sign client assertions for the authorization server's issuer by default when the issuer is known ([#12599](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12599))
- Changed Generic OAuth to check the discovery document's `issuer` against `discoveryUrl`, skipping providers whose issuer does not match ([#12585](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12585))

### Features

- Added `createDpopFetch` in `better-auth/oauth2/dpop-client` for sending DPoP-bound requests with per-origin nonce handling and a single retry on `use_dpop_nonce` ([#12506](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12506))
- Added `endpointType` to custom token endpoint authentication hooks, and `issuer` to hooks and client assertion getters when Better Auth knows it ([#12580](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12580))
- Added a `dpop: { keyPair }` option so Generic OAuth providers can request DPoP-bound tokens (RFC 9449) ([#12596](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12596))
- Added support for pushed authorization requests (RFC 9126) in Generic OAuth sign-in through the new `pushedAuthorizationRequest` option ([#12519](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12519))

### Bug Fixes

- Added `deriveEncryptionKey(secret, purpose)` to `better-auth/crypto` so plugins can derive a separate encryption key for each value they encrypt ([#12577](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12577))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/a3e39fadde8e5c9e966c46c4dde38f46571e4e7a/packages/better-auth/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/oauth-provider`

### ❗ Breaking Changes

- Deprecated the `expectedAudience` strategy input and parameter in favor of `acceptedAudiences` for `clientAuthentication` strategies and `consumeClientAssertion` ([#12599](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12599))
- Changed client assertions such as `private_key_jwt` to require the provider's issuer as their only `aud` value, rejecting endpoint URLs with `invalid_client` ([#12599](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12599))
- Changed access-token claims set to `undefined` to be left out instead of removing a same-named claim from a lower-priority source ([#12575](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12575))
- Changed UserInfo to return `403 insufficient_scope` for access tokens without the `openid` scope and to reject `Authorization` headers without a `Bearer` or `DPoP` scheme ([#12605](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12605))
- Changed `requireActiveAccessToken` to refuse DPoP-bound access tokens with a `401 invalid_token` and a `DPoP` challenge instead of accepting them without checking a proof ([#12606](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12606))

### Features

- Changed token exchange to reject a subject token that carries `authorization_details` with `invalid_request` ([#12509](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12509))
- Added opt-in token exchange for DPoP-bound public clients through `oauthTokenExchange({ publicClients: "dpop-bound" })` ([#12517](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12517))
- Added a pushed authorization request endpoint (`POST /oauth2/par`, RFC 9126) to the OAuth provider, with optional global or per-client enforcement ([#12518](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12518))
- Added a `clientId` option to `provider.authenticateClient()` so plugin endpoints can authenticate follow-up requests that omit `client_id` ([#12529](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12529))
- Added an `expectedJkt` option to `provider.verifyDpopProof()` so plugin endpoints can require a later request to use the same DPoP key as an earlier one ([#12529](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12529))
- feat(oauth-provider): bring DPoP challenges in line with Bearer ([#12579](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12579))
- Added the ability for `adminUpdateOAuthClient` to grant or revoke RP-initiated logout on any client, including ownerless ones, by sending only `enable_end_session` ([#12588](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12588))
- Fixed `updateOAuthClient` to reject new `post_logout_redirect_uris` entries on another origin than the client's `redirect_uris`, for clients that may use RP-initiated logout ([#12588](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12588))
- Changed OAuth provider discovery to publish combined, de-duplicated lists when multiple extensions advertise the same list, such as `authorization_details_types_supported` ([#12564](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12564))
- Added `issueAuthorizationCode` to the OAuth provider API so plugin endpoints can issue authorization codes for a signed-in user without a redirect ([#12565](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12565))
- Changed `/oauth2/authorize` and `/oauth2/par` to reject requests with `authorization_details` using `invalid_authorization_details` when discovery advertises supported types ([#12591](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12591))
- Added support for extension grants to issue RFC 9396 `authorization_details` through `issueTokens` in token responses, JWT access tokens, and introspection ([#12591](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12591))
- Added `challengeDpopNonce()` so plugin endpoints and before hooks can issue a nonce-only DPoP challenge before staging state ([#12522](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12522))
- Improved OAuth provider extension conflict errors and warnings to name the extensions involved, with an optional `name` for extensions ([#12646](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12646))
- Added opt-in revocation of JWT access tokens at `/oauth2/revoke` with `revocableJwtAccessTokens: true` ([#12507](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12507))
- Added `resolveSubject({ userId, client })` to the provider API so grant extensions and companion plugins can get the `sub` a client sees for a user ([#12505](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12505))
- Added opt-in pairwise `sub` in JWT access tokens for pairwise clients with `accessTokenSubject: "pairwise"`, so decoding a token no longer reveals the user ID ([#12505](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12505))
- Added a `clientRegistrationEnableEndSession` option to allow RP-initiated logout at `/oauth2/end-session` for dynamically registered and other registered OAuth clients ([#12510](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12510))
- Fixed introspection of delegated access tokens to show pairwise clients the pairwise `sub` of each user in `act` instead of user IDs ([#12523](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12523))
- Added `accessTokenClaims` from `issueTokens` to opaque access token introspection, so custom grants now see those claims ([#12508](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12508))
- Added `sub_profile` to each actor in a delegated token's `act` claim, marking clients as `"service"` and users as `"user"` ([#12584](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12584))
- Changed token exchange to deny subject tokens whose `may_act` names no actor, with `invalid_request`, instead of allowing any actor ([#12584](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12584))
- Fixed introspection and pairwise JWT access tokens exposing the real user ID in `may_act.sub` to pairwise clients ([#12584](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12584))
- Added revocation of a grant's JWT access tokens when its refresh token is revoked or a code or rotated token is replayed, with `revocableJwtAccessTokens` ([#12520](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12520))
- Changed refresh token revocation at `/oauth2/revoke` to delete every opaque access token of its grant, including those issued before earlier refreshes ([#12520](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12520))
- Added `verifyResourceRequest` to verify JWT and opaque access token requests in-process on plugin endpoints served by the auth server ([#12516](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12516))
- Added a warning when discovery ignores a metadata contribution from an OAuth provider extension or client discovery ([#12574](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12574))
- Improved discovery metadata warnings to log once per server instead of on every request to the well-known endpoints ([#12574](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12574))

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed `authorization_details_types_supported` in protected resource metadata to be typed as `string[]`, matching RFC 9728 ([#12513](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12513))
- Changed the OAuth provider to reserve the `ba_sub` access token claim, dropping custom values for it with a warning ([#12577](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12577))
- Fixed token requests with an already-used DPoP proof consuming an unused authorization code or device code, so clients can retry with a fresh proof ([#12600](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12600))
- Fixed refresh token revocation and replay handling to retry refresh-token family teardown when a delete fails, such as after a MySQL deadlock ([#12643](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12643))
- Fixed authorization code reuse to revoke issued tokens only when the request comes from the original client, including its `code_verifier` for PKCE codes ([#12526](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12526))
- Fixed OAuth grant revocation to also stop token requests for that grant that are still issuing tokens ([#12581](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12581))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/a3e39fadde8e5c9e966c46c4dde38f46571e4e7a/packages/oauth-provider/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/core`

### ❗ Breaking Changes

- Changed `createPrivateKeyJwtClientAssertionGetter` to sign client assertions for the authorization server's issuer by default when the issuer is known ([#12599](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12599))

### Features

- Added `createDpopFetch` in `better-auth/oauth2/dpop-client` for sending DPoP-bound requests with per-origin nonce handling and a single retry on `use_dpop_nonce` ([#12506](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12506))
- Added an `issuer` option to `validateAuthorizationCode`, `refreshAccessToken`, `clientCredentialsToken`, and `pushAuthorizationRequest` for client assertion getters ([#12580](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12580))
- Added `endpointType` to custom token endpoint authentication hooks, and `issuer` to hooks and client assertion getters when Better Auth knows it ([#12580](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12580))
- Added a `fetch` option to `validateAuthorizationCode`, `refreshAccessToken`, `clientCredentialsToken`, and `pushAuthorizationRequest` so requests can send DPoP proofs ([#12596](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12596))
- Added `pushAuthorizationRequest` to `@better-auth/core/oauth2` for sending pushed authorization requests (RFC 9126) and getting the redirect URL ([#12519](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12519))

### Bug Fixes

- Added `use_dpop_nonce` to the `DpopBindingErrorCode` and `DpopProofErrorCode` types exported from `@better-auth/core/oauth2` ([#12511](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12511))
- Fixed `verifyAccessTokenRequest` to reject a missing or unsupported `Authorization` scheme without an `invalid_token` error, matching RFC 6750 ([#12512](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12512))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/a3e39fadde8e5c9e966c46c4dde38f46571e4e7a/packages/core/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/mcp`

### ❗ Breaking Changes

- Changed `requireMcpAuth` to check access tokens against the OAuth provider's records when it runs in the same process, accepting opaque tokens and rejecting revoked ones ([#12597](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12597))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/a3e39fadde8e5c9e966c46c4dde38f46571e4e7a/packages/mcp/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/sso`

### ❗ Breaking Changes

releases.body:
### Patch Changes

- 3c09e00: Prevent in-place schema validation or input refinement from changing approved tool arguments during approval replay.
- f43ee39: fix(workflow): log the default step limit warning when `WorkflowAgent.generate()` stops at the default limit.
- 7ce7ffc: fix(workflow): log provider warnings in `WorkflowAgent`

  `WorkflowAgent.generate()` and `WorkflowAgent.stream()` now log the warnings of every model call through the AI SDK warning logger, like `ToolLoopAgent`. The `AI_SDK_LOG_WARNINGS` global controls the output.

- f6809e3: fix(workflow): align the `prepareStep` results of `WorkflowAgent` with `ToolLoopAgent`. Returned `instructions` (or the deprecated `system`) replace the instructions of the step and carry forward to later steps, returned `providerOptions` are merged with the agent options, and returned `headers` are merged over the headers of the call.
- 2559173: feat(workflow): support `toolApproval` in `WorkflowAgent`

  `WorkflowAgent` accepts a `toolApproval` configuration in the constructor and per `generate()` or `stream()` call. The configuration takes precedence over a tool's `needsApproval` setting, and its functions run in workflow context, outside of the durable model steps. Calls that the configuration approves run in the same step, and calls that it denies receive an `execution-denied` tool result without pausing the workflow.

- f1de9cb: feat(workflow): support the `timeout` object in `WorkflowAgent`

  `generate()` and `stream()` accept `timeout: { totalMs, stepMs, firstChunkMs, chunkMs }` in addition to a number. `stepMs` limits each model call. In `stream()`, `firstChunkMs` and `chunkMs` limit the wait for model output. Invalid timeout values are rejected with an `InvalidArgumentError`. A timeout now also ends a model step when the provider stream ignores the abort signal.

- Updated dependencies [9baa2d0]
  - @ai-sdk/gateway@4.0.146

> - If your SAML IdP sends no email attribute and a `NameID` in another Format or with no Format, send an `email` attribute or the `emailAddress` NameID Format, set `samlConfig.mapping.email` to the attribute it sends, or return the NameID from `mapProfileToUser`. ([#12439](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12439))
> - If your `clientAuthentication` strategy returns a DPoP key (`jkt`), the token type is now `DPoP`, so make your clients send a DPoP proof with each request to a protected resource. ([#12440](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12440))

## `better-auth`

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed `/admin/create-user` leaving a user without a credential account when creating that account failed, such as a database hook throwing, which made retrying with the same email fail with `USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL` ([#12338](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12338))
- Fixed `/admin/create-user` leaving a user without a credential account when the password was rejected, such as by the Have I Been Pwned plugin, which made retrying with the same email fail with `USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL` ([#12335](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12335))
- Fixed client actions ignoring the HTTP method passed in second-argument fetch options, and attaching a request body when the method was a lowercase `get` or `HEAD` ([#12336](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12336))
- Fixed plugin schema overrides (`modelName` and field names) leaking into other instances of the same plugin in one process ([#12319](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12319))
- Fixed `/device/token` returning `invalid_grant` instead of `invalid_client` when `validateClient` rejects the `client_id`, matching `/device/code` and RFC 6749 section 5.2 ([#12246](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12246))
- Fixed OAuth sign-in failing with `state_mismatch` during the daylight saving time fall-back hour when OAuth state is stored in the database and the server's time zone observes daylight saving time ([#12320](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12320))
- Fixed the OpenAPI schema to document query parameters for endpoints whose query schema is wrapped in `z.optional()`, such as `/get-session` and Stripe's `/subscription/list` ([#12337](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12337))
- Fixed `organization.getInvitation` to return the `INVITATION_NOT_FOUND` code for a missing, expired, or non-pending invitation ([#12332](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12332))
- Fixed `listMembers` failing with a syntax error on PostgreSQL and MSSQL when the filter matches no members or the offset is past the last member ([#12318](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12318))
- Fixed the `active-sessions` list in secondary storage being stored without an expiry when every remaining session had less than a second left ([#12323](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12323))
- Fixed SIWE sign-in leaving a user behind when creating its wallet address or account failed, which blocked that wallet from signing in again ([#12366](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12366))
- Fixed social sign-up hanging on single-connection databases when the username plugin is enabled and the provider profile maps a username ([#12340](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12340))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/5de71a89b1294564696dd3bc8161b2ff1ae9cdef/packages/better-auth/CHANGELOG.md)

## `auth`

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed CLI commands hanging or exiting with code 0 at a prompt in CI or without a terminal. They now exit with code 2 and name what they need, such as `--yes`, and prompts appear on stderr so redirecting stdout no longer hides them ([#12286](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12286))
- Fixed CLI notices mixing into command output. `auth info --json --copy` now prints valid JSON, `auth secret` prints only the `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` line on stdout, `auth login` and `auth logout` messages go to stderr, and `auth info` shows tips only in an interactive terminal ([#12287](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12287))
- Fixed CLI errors printing a stack trace instead of the cause. Config and database errors now show their message, and a mistyped `--config` path reports that the file doesn't exist. `auth mcp` and `auth ai` no longer report success after a failed step ([#12305](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12305))
- Fixed the CLI exiting with code 0 after a canceled or failed run. Canceling or declining a prompt, or pressing Ctrl+C, now exits with 130, and failures such as a missing config file or a failed `auth mcp` setup exit with 1 ([#12275](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12275))

For detailed changes, see [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/5de71a89b1294564696dd3bc8161b2ff1ae9cdef/packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md)

## `@better-auth/oauth-provider`

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed `auth.api.oauth2Consent({ headers, body })` failing with `request not found` when called from a server route ([#12325](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12325))
- Fixed a client secret without the configured `prefix.clientSecret` getting a different error than other wrong secrets. It now gets the standard `invalid_client` response: 401 with a `WWW-Authenticate: Basic` challenge for `client_secret_basic`, and 400 for `client_secret_post` ([#12327](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12327))
- Fixed OAuth client `metadata` being stored as a JSON string in its `json` column. It is now written as an object, so Postgres `jsonb` operators such as `->` and `@>` work with adapters that pass JSON through natively (Drizzle `pg`). Rows written as strings by earlier versions are still read ([#12328](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12328))

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Action required**
>
> - fix(oauth-provider)!: reject repeated parameters in form POST authorization requests ([#12261](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/12261))
>
>   A form-encoded POST to `/oauth2/authorize` now follows the same repeated-parameter rules as a GET request. A standard parameter sent more than once, such as `state=a&state=b`, returns `invalid_request` with "state must not appear more than once". Before, the provider used the last value and could issue a code. A repeated `resource` now keeps every value instead of only the last one. A repeated custom parameter, such as `organization`, reaches `postLogin.consentReferenceId` and the signed `oauth_query` with every value. Clients that send each standard parameter once are unaffected.

### Patch Changes

- 5d18351: fix(ai): detect downloaded audio types from bytes when servers return a generic or non-audio content type such as application/octet-stream
- 8da48db: Respect `recordInputs` and `recordOutputs` when delivering telemetry events to integrations and the `ai:telemetry` channel. Filter nested content and omit raw span results when content recording is disabled, while preserving application results.
- fd7e8a7: Preserve the order of text and complete function calls in streamed Google responses, including standalone thought signatures on empty text or reasoning parts.

  Keep provider metadata on empty text parts when converting results to response messages so it can be passed back in subsequent requests.

  Omit foreign-provider empty signature text when replaying history through Anthropic or Bedrock, preserving Bedrock’s existing native reasoning-history handling.

- 36802d4: Support native URL transcription with an optional provider capability, keeping existing file-generation contracts unchanged. Groq sends HTTP(S) audio URLs through its `url` parameter without downloading and re-uploading them, avoiding the attachment upload limit. Supplying a custom `download` function retains local download behavior.

  For telemetry integrations, `TranscriptionEndEvent.audio.byteLength` and `audio.mediaType` can now be `undefined` when a provider fetches the audio URL natively. Check for missing values before using them as a number or string. Downloaded and inline audio continue to report their metadata; streaming transcription metadata is unchanged.

  Strip media fragments before sending URLs to Groq. If Groq rejects a redirect, fall back to the existing secure local downloader and file upload rather than failing previously working URL inputs. Other provider errors are preserved.

- 933dae3: fix (ai): download deprecated `file-url` and `image-url` tool result content

  Tool result content parts that use the deprecated `file-url` and `image-url`
  types were converted to `file` parts with `{ type: 'url' }` data, but they were
  never passed to the download function. When the model does not support the URL,
  the provider received a bare URL instead of the file contents, even though the
  replacement `file` part with `{ type: 'url' }` data was downloaded and inlined.

  Downloaded legacy URL parts now use the same media type normalization as file
  parts, resolving generic types from the response header or image bytes.
  Legacy base64 data URLs also normalize to inline data with the media type from
  their data URL, matching replacement file parts.

- e0143b0: feat(ai): support provider-owned realtime transports

  Add an optional `createTransport` interface and `provider` connection capability.

- 934100c: Report the actual OpenAI Chat HTTP endpoint (also used by Azure Chat and Bedrock Mantle Chat) through optional request metadata and model-call end events. Record its host and port on OpenTelemetry chat spans without exposing URL credentials, paths, queries, or fragments. Expose only the sanitized HTTP origin in text and object generation results and step/finish callbacks. Providers that do not report an endpoint leave these attributes unset.
- c389374: fix(ai): infer union output types when passing a union of schemas to `Output.object` and `Output.array`

  Previously, passing a schema whose type is a union of schemas (e.g. a schema selected from a map at runtime) failed to type-check because the output type was inferred from the first union member only. The output type is now inferred as the union of the schemas' output types.

- 892af4d: feat (ai): re-export realtime server-connection and usage types

  Adds `Experimental_RealtimeServerConnection`, `Experimental_RealtimeSessionIntent`, and `Experimental_RealtimeUsage` aliases for the new experimental `RealtimeModelV4` server-side spec types.

- 9754014: Add typed streaming heartbeat parts. Anthropic emits them only with `includePings: true` (disabled by default), without requiring raw chunks. Core forwards pings through stream retries without storing them as generated content or sending them to UI message streams. Consumers with exhaustive stream-part switches must handle the new `ping` union variant when upgrading, even when the opt-in is disabled. Typed pings do not flush partial words during stream smoothing.

releases.body:
## 📦 New builders: Bun, Rspack and Rsbuild

In addition to Rolldown, Rollup and Vite, Nitro can now build your server with three new **experimental** builders:

| Builder | Use it with |
| --- | --- |
| **Bun** ([#4987](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/4987)) | `bun --bun nitro build` (selected automatically on Bun when `rolldown`/`vite` are not installed) |
| **Rspack** ([#4942](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/4942)) | `builder: "rspack"` or `NITRO_BUILDER=rspack` |
| **Rsbuild** ([#5011](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/5011)) | the `nitro()` plugin from `nitro/rsbuild` in `rsbuild.config.ts` |

All builders run the same Rollup-compatible plugins: Nitro's own, your [`buildPlugins`](https://nitro.build/config/build#buildplugins) and the ones presets add. So all Nitro features and deployment presets work with each builder.

### ⚡ Bun builder

```sh
bun --bun nitro build
```

The Bun builder bundles with `Bun.build`. It works with any preset (not only `bun`) and with `nitro dev`. Pass extra options with the new `bunConfig` option.

### 🦀 Rspack builder

```ts [nitro.config.ts]
export default defineConfig({ builder: "rspack" });
```

The Rspack builder bundles the server with [Rspack](https://rspack.rs) v2.3+. Like `rolldown` and `vite`, `@rspack/core` is installed on demand. It is not a dependency of Nitro. Load and transform filters become native Rspack loader conditions, so less work goes through JS. There is also a new `rspack` template for `nitro create`.

### 🧩 `nitro/rsbuild` plugin

```ts [rsbuild.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from "@rsbuild/core";
import { nitro } from "nitro/rsbuild";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [nitro()],
});
```

This plugin works like `nitro/vite`, using the environments API of [Rsbuild](https://rsbuild.rs). Client, SSR and the Nitro server compile in one Rsbuild compiler. `rsbuild dev`, `build`, `build --watch` and `preview` work with Nitro, as do SSR outlets in the HTML template, `?assets` imports and `services`. It also works with environments from other plugins, for example TanStack Start (`@tanstack/react-start/plugin/rsbuild`). 👉 [Rsbuild docs](https://nitro.build/docs/rsbuild) · examples: [`rsbuild-ssr-html`](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/tree/main/examples/rsbuild-ssr-html), [`rsbuild-ssr-react`](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/tree/main/examples/rsbuild-ssr-react), [`rsbuild-ssr-tss-react`](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/tree/main/examples/rsbuild-ssr-tss-react)

> [!NOTE]
> These builders are experimental: their behavior may change in minor releases. Known limits are listed in each PR. For example, `emitFile` only supports assets, and with Bun, library chunks are not grouped.

## 🔌 Shared `services` + `fetchService()` ([#5023](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/5023))

Services are now part of Nitro core, with the same config and runtime API for `nitro/vite` and `nitro/rsbuild`:

```ts [nitro.config.ts]
export default defineConfig({
  services: { api: { entry: "./src/api-entry.ts" } },
});
```

```ts
import { fetchService } from "nitro/services";

const res = await fetchService("api", "/hello");
```

An `ssr` service is detected from an `entry-server` file. Your HTML template can render `<!--ssr-outlet-->` and use `fetchService` in its context. `vite.services` and `fetchViteEnv()` keep working as deprecated aliases.

## 🧱 Renderer templates compiled at build time ([#5019](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/5019))

The renderer template is now compiled at build time, in dev and production, with all builders. Templates are no longer evaluated at runtime (`new Function`), so template syntax works in dev on workerd/Cloudflare too ([#5014](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/5014)). Syntax errors name the template file. With Vite dev, page requests no longer wait for `transformIndexHtml` (~306 ms → ~3 ms per page request in a benchmark with a slow HTML plugin). This release also fixes `fetchViteEnv is not defined` during prerendering.

## ⚡ Vite integration

- **Built-in `?assets` imports** ([#5013](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/5013)): `?assets` imports are now built into Nitro, based on the original work by Hiroshi Ogawa (@hi-ogawa). `nitro/rsbuild` supports them too.
- **Vite `base` ⇄ Nitro `baseURL`** ([#5022](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/5022)): `vite build --base /app/` now serves routes and assets under `/app/`. Without a Vite `base`, Nitro `baseURL` is used as the Vite `base`. A `baseURL` set explicitly in Nitro config always wins.
- **Missing hashed assets return a `no-store` 404** ([#5020](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/pull/5020)): A request for an old chunk during a deploy no longer gets the HTML page with an immutable one-year cache header.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Behavior changes:** Server routes under the client `assetsDir` (`/assets/` by default) now return 404 in production builds. With only a Vite `base` set, dev now matches production. Set `baseURL: "/"` to keep the server at the root.

> 4.6.4 is a security release. It fixes [eight advisories in Nuxt](https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/security/advisories) and pulls in `nitropack` 2.13.6, which fixes [three more in Nitro](https://github.com/nitrojs/nitro/security/advisories). We recommend upgrading as soon as you can.

## ⚠️ Behaviour changes

These probably won't affect most apps, but it's worth flagging anyway:

1. **Error details in production.** When a page fails to render on the server, the error page and the payload now only carry message and data of errors you create with `createError`. Everything else is stripped.
2. **Dev server `Host` checks.** Webpack and rspack dev servers now reject requests with an unexpected `Host` header, as Vite already does. If you use a custom hostname or tunnel, you'll need to add it to the new `devServer.allowedHosts` option.
3. **`workspaceDir` detection.** When `workspaceDir` isn't set, Nuxt now only widens it past `rootDir` to an explicit workspace root or the closest git repository. 
4. **Nitropack cached routes.** `cache`, `swr` and `isr` route rules now only cache `GET` and `HEAD` requests, and no longer store responses that set a cookie or send `Cache-Control: private` or `no-store`. Wildcard `proxy` and `redirect` rules also reject requests whose resolved target would leave the rule's scope.
5. **Route rules and encoded slashes.** Route rules now match paths that contain encoded slashes, so `/api%2Fadmin` is covered by a `/api/**` rule.
